title: Read the default branch in the tracker
body:
The tracker hard-codes `origin/main` (`src/task/store.ts:313-316`, `src/task/claims.ts:550`), so in a `master` repository the closed-in-origin claim condition is silently skipped (review A8).
Acceptance: the tracker resolves `origin/HEAD` (or the configured default branch) and tests cover a `master` repository.
